name: Sakurai Yumemi
source:
Five years have passed since her defilement at the hands of [url=/c56450]Rengo[/url]. 

She has moved to another town and now lives in a one-bedroom apartment with her favourite insect. 

The only thing she wants is a quiet and peaceful everyday life, free of worry and anxiety.

While she gets money from a mysterious benefactor, she doesn't want to depend on him. Thus, she has started working part-time at Café Anzu.

[Based on the [url=https://www.cyc-soft.com/b-cyc-pro/extra/cha/extra_cha_02_1_1.htm]official description[/url]]
